name: Message Protection 1 Code
definition: Mechanism used to protect the message of the ATM protocol.

EVLP.name: Enveloped Message
EVLP.definition: Messages contain an encrypted body and a MAC or a digital signature computed on the complete message (header plus body after encryption).

MACB.name: MAC Body
MACB.definition: Messages contain a MAC or a digital signature computed on the body only.

MACM.name: MAC Message
MACM.definition: Messages contain a MAC or a digital signature computed on the complete message (header plus body).

UNPR.name: No Protection
UNPR.definition: Messages are not protected, no encryption and no MAC or digital signature.
